verdict.rationale: Lineage is a fair question for an ELT/data-integration platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any lineage view that traces which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table. Adjacent features do not count as lineage: the Connection Timeline (historical connection events and logs), the one-to-one stream-to-table mapping, and triggering dbt Cloud jobs after syncs.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see end-to-end lineage of my datasets — which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table
